# Widgets Blocks

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
- [Archives](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-archives/) — `core/archives`: Displays a date archive of your posts.
- [Calendar](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-calendar/) — `core/calendar`: Displays a calendar of your site’s posts.
- [Terms List](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-categories/) — `core/categories`: Displays a list of all terms of a given taxonomy.
- [Custom HTML](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-html/) — `core/html`: Adds custom HTML code and preview it as you edit.
- [Latest Comments](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-latest-comments/) — `core/latest-comments`: Displays a list of your most recent comments.
- [Latest Posts](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-latest-posts/) — `core/latest-posts`: Displays a list of your most recent posts.
- [Page List](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-page-list/) — `core/page-list`: Displays a list of all pages.
- [Page List Item](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-page-list-item/) — `core/page-list-item`: Displays a page inside a list of all pages.
- [RSS](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-rss/) — `core/rss`: Displays entries from any RSS or Atom feed.
- [Search](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-search/) — `core/search`: Helps visitors find your content.
- [Shortcode](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-shortcode/) — `core/shortcode`: Inserts additional custom elements with a WordPress shortcode.
- [Social Icon](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-social-link/) — `core/social-link`: Displays an icon linking to a social profile or site.
- [Social Icons](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-social-links/) — `core/social-links`: Displays icons linking to your social profiles or sites.
- [Tag Cloud](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-widgets/core-block-tag-cloud/) — `core/tag-cloud`: Displays a cloud of popular keywords, each sized by how often it appears.
